description: Store encrypted network credentials and choose, for each of the eight event families (install, session, trial, subscription, purchase, refund, paywall, business), which source's copy AttriKit forwards to the network. AttriKit always does the sending; the owner only picks the copy. attrkit = the events your app reports through the AttriKit SDK (the RevenueCat copy of that family is dropped). revenuecat = the events AttriKit received from your RevenueCat webhook (the SDK copy is dropped); RevenueCat itself sends nothing to the network. customer = events your own servers post to AttriKit. If your app reports subscriptions only through RevenueCat, set trial, subscription, purchase and refund to revenuecat, or none of them reach the network. For Meta and TikTok, delivery_scope and renewal_event are optional; left out, the integration sends every install's events and renewals as Purchase.

account_ref.description: The ad account: for Meta the ad account ID starting with act_, for Google the Ads customer ID (123-456-7890), for TikTok the advertiser ID.

credential.description: The network credential, a JSON object written as a string. Meta: pixelId and accessToken. Google: linkId (conversions), accessToken and developerToken (spend). TikTok: eventSourceId (your Pixel code) and accessToken. Stored encrypted and never returned.

delivery_scope.description: Which events a Meta or TikTok integration sends. all (the API's default): the events of every install with measurement consent, organic ones included. attributed: send only events of installs AttriKit attributes to this connection's network (click ID, link token, or a Matched install at or above the delivery floor); others are suppressed with attributed_only_suppressed. Meta and TikTok only: a Google integration refuses attributed.

enable.description: true starts delivery at once, which needs all eight families in owners. false (the default) saves a draft that sends nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

network.description: The ad network: meta, google or tiktok.

owners.description: For each event family, whose copy is forwarded: attrkit, revenuecat or customer (see the tool description). Enabling a destination requires ALL eight families to be present, or the API rejects the call.

renewal_event.description: How a renewal reaches Meta website and TikTok web events. purchase (the API's default): as Purchase with its price and currency. custom: as the custom event subscription_renewed with its price and currency, so Purchase counts one-time purchases only. App events are unchanged. A Google integration refuses custom.
